nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 collateral asset held in custody by the locker.
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to withdraw collateral.
Constructor initializing collateralAsset and loan immutable state variables.
External function guarded by isLoan that transfers collateral to a destination.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the loan address.
Caller identity checked against the loan state variable for authorization.
External ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary destination address, executed via SafeERC20.
Constructor parameter providing the collateral asset address.
Constructor parameter providing the authorized loan address.
Destination address for the collateral transfer.
Amount of collateral asset to transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the loan state variable inside the isLoan modifier require statement.
The loan state variable is read in the isLoan modifier to authorize the caller.
The isLoan modifier gates entry into the pull function body.
Caller identity ultimately controls whether pull can execute.
_collateralAsset parameter is consumed by the constructor to set state.
_loan parameter is consumed by the constructor to set state.
_collateralAsset is assigned to the collateralAsset state variable.
_loan is assigned to the loan state variable.
dst parameter is passed into the pull function body.
amt parameter is passed into the pull function body.
pull executes the external safeTransfer unsafe operation.
dst flows directly into the external token transfer destination.
amt flows directly into the external token transfer amount.
collateralAsset is the token target of the safeTransfer call.
The external ERC20 call transfers control to a token contract that could re-enter pull before returning.

normalization_plan.reason: _collateralAsset is a constructor parameter that only feeds the constructor and is merged into that core function.
_loan is a constructor parameter that only feeds the constructor and is merged into that core function.
